summary_1line: Rama renounces royal comforts, dons bark garments with Lakshmana and Sita, while court women and sage Vasishtha protest Sita’s exile and rebuke Kaikeyi.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the royal court, Rama gently ties rough bark garments over Sita’s silk sari as the palace women weep around them.
Kaikeyi stands unashamed in the assembly, holding out the bark robes to Rama while the stunned court watches.
Sita, confused and tearful, holds the awkward bark cloth around her neck like a startled doe while Rama steps forward to help her.
